summary: Layer 1B expansion supports the hypothesis that grid electrical hardware is a practical chokepoint for data-center, utility, electrification, and power-generation buildouts. The reference lane uses Eaton as a category anchor for broad electrical distribution, utility power distribution, busway, switchgear, transformers, and data-center exposure. The underfollowed lane highlights Powell Industries as a more direct medium-voltage switchgear / packaged power / substation-equipment candidate, and Preformed Line Products as a lower-attention substation hardware, transmission/distribution accessory, and HV/EHV connector supplier. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
